 b3.PARENT_MATERIAL_ID p3, m3.MATERIAL_DESC d3, m3.MATERIAL_TYP t3, b3.QTY_PER q3, b3.EFF_TO e3
FROM dbo.BOM b1 LEFT JOIN dbo.MATERIAL m1 ON m1.MATERIAL_ID=b1.PARENT_MATERIAL_ID
LEFT JOIN dbo.BOM b2 ON b2.CHILD_MATERIAL_ID=b1.PARENT_MATERIAL_ID LEFT JOIN dbo.MATERIAL m2 ON m2.MATERIAL_ID=b2.PARENT_MATERIAL_ID
LEFT JOIN dbo.BOM b3 ON b3.CHILD_MATERIAL_ID=b2.PARENT_MATERIAL_ID LEFT JOIN dbo.MATERIAL m3 ON m3.MATERIAL_ID=b3.PARENT_MATERIAL_ID
WHERE b1.CHILD_MATERIAL_ID='RM-103'
SELECT * FROM dbo.BOM_FLAT_LEGACY WHERE COMPONENT_MATERIAL_ID='RM-103'

SELECT b.CHILD_MATERIAL_ID, b.PARENT_MATERIAL_ID, m.MATERIAL_DESC, m.MATERIAL_TYP, m.PACK_SZ, b.QTY_PER, b.EFF_FROM, b.EFF_TO FROM dbo.BOM b LEFT JOIN dbo.MATERIAL m ON m.MATERIAL_ID=b.PARENT_MATERIAL_ID WHERE b.CHILD_MATERIAL_ID IN ('FILL-2001','FILL-2002','FG-1001','FG-1002','FG-1003','RM-103','SEMI-044','SEMI-045','CMP-320','SEMI-060','FILL-1001','FILL-1002','FILL-1003') ORDER BY 1
SELECT x.*, m.MATERIAL_DESC, m.PACK_SZ FROM dbo.MATERIAL_NDC_XREF x LEFT JOIN dbo.MATERIAL m ON m.MATERIAL_ID=x.MATERIAL_ID

SELECT pm.PLANT_ID, pm.MATERIAL_ID FROM dbo.PLANT_MATERIAL pm WHERE pm.MATERIAL_ID IN ('RM-103','SEMI-044','SEMI-045','CMP-320','SEMI-060','FILL-1001','FILL-1002','FILL-1003','FILL-2001','FILL-2002','FG-1001','FG-1002','FG-1003','FG-2001','FG-2002')

SELECT i.DC_ID, i.MATERIAL_ID, i.SNAPSHOT_DT, i.ON_HAND_UNITS, i.SAFETY_STOCK_UNITS FROM dbo.DC_INV i WHERE i.MATERIAL_ID IN ('FG-1001','FG-1002','FG-1003','FG-2001','FG-2002','RM-103','SEMI-044','SEMI-045','CMP-320','SEMI-060') AND i.SNAPSHOT_DT=(SELECT MAX(SNAPSHOT_DT) FROM dbo.DC_INV) ORDER BY 2,1

SELECT MATERIAL_ID, DC_ID, COUNT(*) n, MIN(SHIP_DT) mn, MAX(SHIP_DT) mx, SUM(CASE WHEN SHIP_DT> DATEADD(day,-91,'2026-09-30') THEN UNITS ELSE 0 END) u13w FROM dbo.WHSLR_SHIP WHERE MATERIAL_ID IN ('FG-1001','FG-1002','FG-1003','FG-2001','FG-2002') GROUP BY MATERIAL_ID, DC_ID ORDER BY 1,2
SELECT DISTINCT MATERIAL_ID FROM dbo.DC_INV WHERE MATERIAL_ID NOT LIKE 'FG-30%'
SELECT DC_ID, MATERIAL_ID, SNAPSHOT_DT, ON_HAND_UNITS, SAFETY_STOCK_UNITS FROM dbo.DC_INV WHERE MATERIAL_ID IN ('FG-1001','FG-1002') AND SNAPSHOT_DT>='2026-07-01' ORDER BY 2,1,3

SELECT MATERIAL_ID, WHSLR_ID, DATEADD(day, -((DATEDIFF(day,'2026-09-26',SHIP_DT)%7+7)%7), SHIP_DT) wk, SUM(UNITS) u FROM dbo.WHSLR_SHIP WHERE DC_ID='DC-EAST' AND MATERIAL_ID IN ('FG-1001','FG-1002') AND SHIP_DT>='2026-06-20' GROUP BY MATERIAL_ID, WHSLR_ID, DATEADD(day, -((DATEDIFF(day,'2026-09-26',SHIP_DT)%7+7)%7), SHIP_DT) ORDER BY 1,2,3
SELECT w.*, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.WHSLR_SHIP s WHERE s.WHSLR_ID=w.WHSLR_ID) n FROM dbo.WHSLR w

SELECT TABLE_NAME, COLUMN_NAME FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE COLUMN_NAME LIKE '%PRICE%' OR COLUMN_NAME LIKE '%COST%' OR COLUMN_NAME LIKE '%WAC%' OR COLUMN_NAME LIKE '%USD%' OR COLUMN_NAME LIKE '%AMT%'

SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME, COLUMN_NAME, COMMENT FROM PHARMA_DEMO.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE COLUMN_NAME ILIKE ANY ('%PRICE%','%COST%','%WAC%','%USD%','%AMT%') OR COMMENT IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME, COLUMN_NAME, COMMENT FROM PHARMA_DEMO.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA<>'INFORMATION_SCHEMA' AND (COLUMN_NAME ILIKE ANY ('%PRICE%','%COST%','%WAC%','%USD%','%AMT%') OR COMMENT IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT MATERIAL_ID, DC_ID, WHSLR_ID, SUM(UNITS) u13, MIN(SHIP_DT) mn, MAX(SHIP_DT) mx FROM dbo.WHSLR_SHIP WHERE MATERIAL_ID IN ('FG-1001','FG-1002','FG-1003','FG-2001','FG-2002') AND SHIP_DT BETWEEN '2026-06-27' AND '2026-09-25' GROUP BY MATERIAL_ID, DC_ID, WHSLR_ID ORDER BY 1,2,3
